title: Elevator Requests III
statement: An elevator begins at floor start at time 0 in a building of n floors and each second may move one floor up, one floor down, or stay where it is. A request [arrival, floor] is satisfied the instant the elevator stands on that floor at any time at or after its arrival time, so the elevator may need to idle on a floor until the request appears. With at most 16 requests, return the earliest time by which all of them have been satisfied.
